card.name: "These effects are" before usually reversible
card.fires_on: The word "are" in the sentence "These effects are usually reversible", which follows a warning about worsening kidney function or acute renal failure with NSAIDs, ARBs, ACE inhibitors or aliskiren.

modes.label: Renal effects reversible
modes.description: The verb "are" after "These effects" in a drug-interaction warning on kidney function, just before "usually reversible".
modes.example: NSAIDs, including COX-2 inhibitors, with ENTRESTO may result in worsening of renal function, including possible acute renal failure. These effects<< are>> usually reversible. Monitor renal function periodically.

card.plain: It marks the verb in the stock sentence saying kidney effects from these drug combinations are usually reversible.
